status: candidate registry; arrays and splits not yet frozen
purpose: Select a diverse confirmatory suite without consulting model performance.

license_policy.required: A dataset must permit redistribution of the frozen numeric artifact, or the artifact must be generated locally from an immutable source by the user.
license_policy.verification_rule: Recheck the license displayed on each source page and record it in the final manifest before downloading or redistributing arrays.

selection_rules.outcome: A continuous regression target with at least 100 usable observations.
selection_rules.performance_blinding: Eligibility, preprocessing, and replacement decisions must be made without running EvoForest or any comparison method.
selection_rules.replacement: Within each size quota, take candidates in ascending priority. Replace an ineligible candidate with the next candidate in the same size stratum; never replace based on observed predictive performance.
selection_rules.row_cap: No confirmatory task may exceed 50,000 rows. Do not performance-select a subsample. If a lower compute cap is required, define one deterministic source-order or seeded sample rule for every task before any method is run.
selection_rules.feature_policy: Remove documented row identifiers, free text, and alternate targets. Retain genuine numeric predictors. Encode nominal predictors by a mapping frozen from the training partition only and add an unknown category for validation/test.
selection_rules.missing_policy: Preserve raw missingness in the frozen artifact. Fit imputation on training data only inside each method pipeline and provide a missingness indicator when supported.
selection_rules.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate feature vectors must remain in one partition.
selection_rules.split_policy: Use 60/20/20 seeded grouped random partitions for IID tasks; chronological partitions for temporal tasks; subject-group partitions for repeated-measure tasks. Split rules and seeds must be written before evaluation.
selection_rules.multi_target_policy: Use only the target named in this registry and remove every alternate response from the predictors.
selection_rules.agent_blinding: Expose x0, x1, ... to feature-generating agents. Preserve semantic names only in provenance metadata.
selection_rules.sealed_test_policy: Test labels remain inaccessible until method, budget, hyperparameter, and graph selection are complete.
